articles.title: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh along with Tri-Service-Chiefs, CDS pays tribute to 1971 War heroes at National War Memorial
articles.summary: India commemorated its 54th Vijay Diwas with a solemn wreath-laying ceremony at the National War Memorial in New Delhi. This day marks the decisive victory of the Indian Armed Forces in the 1971 War, leading to the liberation of Bangladesh. It serves as a powerful reminder of the bravery and sacrifice of Indian soldiers, inspiring future aspirants to uphold the nation's honour and military prowess.

articles.title: Amazon says will invest $35bn in India by 2030
articles.summary: E-commerce giant Amazon announced plans to nearly double its investment in India, aiming to significantly expand exports, create jobs, and further develop artificial intelligence capabilities within the country. This strategic move highlights India's growing economic significance and its potential as a global market and technology hub, promising substantial economic impact and employment opportunities across various sectors.
